inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {ℓ r S : ℕ} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ}
  {μ : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ} {L G : ℕ},
  1 ≤ L →
    (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ μ x) →
      ∑ x, μ x = 1 →
        (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), μ x ≠ 0 → QuarticQuery.promised f x) →
          (∀ (U : QuarticQuery.QueryTree κ), U.depth ≤ L → QuarticQuery.treeSuccess f μ U ≤ 2 / 3) →
            ∀ (T : QuarticQuery.QueryTree (QuarticQuery.BitLoc ℓ r S κ)),
              T.depth ≤ G →
                (QuarticQuery.coupledAvg μ fun A J I => QuarticQuery.Paper.cellVisit f T J A I) ≤
                  ↑G / (↑(2 ^ ℓ) * ↑L) + ↑G * (2 / 3) ^ r

lean.note: The conclusion is the average original-law cellVisit event bounded by G/(mL)+G(2/3)^r with m=2^ℓ. coupledAvg samples an independent uniformly chosen I. The event is an unsplit cell encounter, not a conditional distribution.
